heading: Salary
text: The pay rate is $25 per hour.

heading: Acceptance
text: You must sign and return the offer by November 6, 2026.

heading: Benefits
text: You must submit benefits forms by November 20, 2026.

heading: Notice
text: Employees must give two weeks notice before resigning.

heading: Terms
text: Nonexempt means eligible for overtime pay under this offer.

heading: Fee
text: The training fee of $50 is waived and will not be charged.
